name: dsh-subagent-model-router
description: Subagent model routing for DeepSeek Harness: spawn a child on a chosen provider/model, re-route a live child repeatedly, and enforce a per-Session allowlist of child models from the composer dock. Works with or without Agent Teams.

scripts.test: node test/smoke.mjs && node test/generic.smoke.mjs && node test/client.smoke.mjs
scripts.test:smoke: node test/smoke.mjs && node test/generic.smoke.mjs && node test/client.smoke.mjs

compat.note: Seams were read from this build; a different dsh line may rename them. The plugin warns and degrades instead of crashing, but treat it as untested.

summary.en: Subagent model routing: spawn a child on a chosen provider/model, switch a live child's model repeatedly, and enforce a per-Session allowlist of child models. Independent of Agent Teams.
summary.zh: 子智能体模型路由：创建时指定 provider/model、运行中可反复切换模型，并按会话强门禁限制可用的子智能体模型；不依赖 Agent Teams。
